12  We are working to increase awareness of the ombudsman's office and encouraging bankers to use the ombudsman for matters that cannot be resolved at the local level.
The ombudsman has broad authority to investigate claims of retaliation, and, when appropriate, will report complaints to the Board.
The Board will not tolerate retaliation against banking organizations that file appeals or raise concerns about the supervisory process.
